name: create-t3-app-local
description: Zero-input local install of an opinionated T3 stack (Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, tRPC, Drizzle, better-auth) wired to a shared local Postgres (Homebrew postgresql@16) with per-project isolated databases and least-privilege roles. Ships a project-aware MCP server (auto-registered via the plugin manifest) so Claude Desktop and Cowork can query each project's DB. Runs end-to-end on macOS or Linux.
